tasks.name: Test Task - Verify MCP Server Integration
tasks.description:
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs! 🐛💡

This test task validates that the task-and-research MCP server is properly configured and operational within the Logos API project. It demonstrates the complete task lifecycle: creation, analysis, reflection, and splitting.
tasks.notes: This is a meta-task for infrastructure validation, not a feature implementation task.
tasks.implementationGuide: No code implementation required. This task tests the task management infrastructure itself.
tasks.verificationCriteria:
- Task successfully created in .mcp-tasks/ directory
- Task analysis workflow completed
- Task reflection performed
- Task splitting demonstrated
- All MCP server tools accessible
